subject: TARGET CLAIM: security-state visual authorization / stale-pixel fencing
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-security-rd-visual-security-authorization-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. BOUNDARY=visual authorization only: prove and design a monotonic security-context epoch so cached/frozen bitmap pixels captured before keyguard/device-lock transition cannot be presented afterward or resurrected by stale callbacks. Fail closed while keyguard is showing; re-sample current KeyguardManager state at presentation boundaries; broadcasts are hints only. EXPLICIT NON-GOALS=no continuity state thresholds, cover lease/CAS, panel power/routing, mirror geometry, frame pacing, input gating, semantic navigation freshness, app-process recovery, or production file writes. Adjacent historic frame-provenance/content-freshness work remains authoritative for cycle/context freshness; this claim adds a separate security authorization dimension.
